title: Agents bootstrap themselves into their own worktree automatically
goal: An agent must land in its own worktree without anyone telling it: (1) scripts/susi-worktree.sh works with no name (auto <agent>-<timestamp>), runs setup-dev.sh in the new worktree, parks the primary checkout and prints 'cd <path>' last; (2) 'susi workflow start [name]' wraps it; (3) the guard's refusal in the primary checkout names that one command; (4) every agent tool's auto-loaded file (CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .cursor/rules, .github/copilot-instructions.md, plus a Claude Code SessionStart hook) points at 'susi workflow check' and the worktree command; AGENTS.md remains the single source. Tests in tests/agent_bootstrap.rs.
